policy: Only evidenced existing physical endpoints connect (identical vertices, an explicit kind=shortLink reviewed link of at most 30 m between two existing surveyed vertices, or a kind=osmConnector reviewed OpenStreetMap path with stubs of at most 50 m and total length of at most 1500 m). A kind=osmTrack entry adds surveyed OpenStreetMap geometry for one existing identity between two of its own vertices, from one of its vertices to a reviewed terminus (a dead-end platform within 300 m of terminus.coordinate, the station N02 group coordinate; the from-attach stays at most 50 m), or, with endJunction, along its own identity to a stub of at most 50 m onto an existing vertex of a different identity. That stub is one reviewed junction hop. The track vertices themselves do not change identity. Passenger transfers and display seams do not add rail edges.
